tidbit: Did you know… about 17,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia faces headwinds from US regulations as China's AI semiconductor market share drops to 34 percent, reported by 블루밍비트.
An OpenAI employee was arrested by the FBI over a hidden device, while Anthropic warns of self-replicating artificial intelligence spreading to smart devices, reported by Brave New Coin.
OpenAI discovered a listening bug in its office linked to a Saudi-born engineer, reported by Al Jazeera.
Anthropic successfully runs a large language model on 15 old TV set-top boxes, demonstrating self-replication in IoT devices, reported by 36Kr.
Samsung Electronics showcased comprehensive AI semiconductor technologies including HBM4E at a semiconductor exhibition and plans a 360 trillion won investment in Yongin, confirmed by 연합뉴스.
Free every hour.
